scope: scaffold / cpu5_arch_spec_v0_3 sections 10.1-2; not section 9 stage 1 PLL
current_scaffold_semantics: metadata-only elastic pipeline; no ISA execution; retirement, GPR/CSR/MMIO/D/M/trap/BP architecture actions disabled

sampling.registered_observation: post-NBA reports decisions from the same edge; external pre-edge observations are one edge later
sampling.reset: asynchronous active-low; assertions disabled while rst_n==0
sampling.retire_fire: unique MEM normal architecture completion event; not wb_we
sampling.instret_increment: exactly once from current retire_fire at decision edge; not again from delayed retire_valid
sampling.wb: consumes previously retired MEM/WB owner once; older WB may write during younger trap

age.allocation_event: cpu5_ifid_accept: new packet first enters IF/ID; never reallocate a held packet
age.on_exhaustion: all-ones seq is terminal reserved; mask IF/ID valid and stop response admission; simulation fatal; reset required, no normal progress or last-packet completion claim
age.flush_rule: kill live packets younger than source seq; source consumption is event-specific; IRQ cancels all unretired cancellable packets
age.epoch_role: IF request/response path generation only; held/outstanding stale is sticky until drained
age.owner_liveness: seq age and killed; never owner_epoch!=current_fetch_epoch
age.skeleton_flush_cut: first killed seq: branch source+1; sync Trap fault source; IRQ first unretired; upstream cancels killed IF/ID on the same flush protocol

frontend.reuse: old if_stage unchanged through cpu5_if_adapter; direct registered IF/ID alias, no unconditional extra data register
frontend.fault: sticky imem_fault must become one correctly aged PC-bound fault packet; no early trap
gates: IF01 ID hold while response arrives: no loss/overwrite
IF02 redirect plus hold: preserve accepted source and kill only younger work
IF03 held/outstanding stale response: drain without packet or fault admission
IF04 sticky fault: one packet with original PC; older work first
IF05 safe MEM BP training once; no duplicate or wrong-path update
IF06 request valid/address/metadata stable under long backpressure
IF07 old response plus new request at one edge: distinct old/new descriptors

hazard.latest_not_ready: stall; never fall back to older same-rd WB
hazard.id_branch: no long EX-to-ID combinational forwarding; matching EX producer stalls; ready MEM/WB may forward
hazard.branch_resolve_parameter: BRANCH_RESOLVE_IN_ID retained for A/B; final selection NOT FROZEN

d_port.ex_speculation: only aligned full-access-width-contained ordinary RAM LOAD in explicit non-overflowing whitelist
d_port.side_effect_authorization: oldest live MEM, commit-qualified, no known fault/older flush, before first valid presentation
d_port.old_store_device_barrier: no younger EX LOAD presentation/fire until older STORE/MMIO/Stats/unknown transaction completed/drained; regardless of address alias
d_port.presented_request: valid/address/write/size/wdata/wstrb stable until handshake; cannot be withdrawn on redirect/IRQ
d_port.same_edge_handoff: only successful live old pure RAM LOAD response to new pure RAM LOAD; old response consumes old owner before new owner assignment
d_port.killed_response: drain/drop only; no retirement, GPR, CSR, BP or trap

m_owner.start: once, idle resource, no old owner/drain, live EX M, no known older flush
m_owner.initial_conservative_gate: do not start younger M while older MEM has unresolved fault or memory risk; owner/killed still required
m_owner.fast_path: DIV/REM zero and signed INT_MIN/-1 may set done=1,busy=0 on accepted start edge; consume earliest next pre-edge
m_owner.sticky_done: same generation exactly once; never consume result on new start edge; do not require observable done-low/busy-high for fast path
m_owner.killed: retain owner, background drain/drop completion, no architected result; only new M waits for busy resource
m_owner.progress: trap, ordinary ALU and CSR must not be blocked forever by killed M; ISR M waits resource then starts with fresh generation

irq.arm: previous-edge qualified candidate, always rechecked using current committed state
irq.eligibility: current pre-edge committed mstatus/mie/mip; recheck and cancel invalid candidate
irq.mepc: pre-edge arch_next_pc_q, not speculative PC or unretired MEM PC
irq.irrevocable_transaction: presented/accepted incomplete STORE/device drains before IRQ; completion retires once, IRQ at next safe edge
irq.csr_mret_boundary: T0 retirement updates CSR and arch_next_pc; T1 eligibility and mepc use newly committed values
irq.armed_before_disable: if eligible and safe, IRQ wins before unretired CSR-disable/MRET; it cannot alter committed state in advance
irq.continuous_alu_bound: after first sampled persistent synchronized pending, take by next edge if eligibility and safe boundary persist
irq.blocked_bound: no numeric bound with unbounded endpoint backpressure; take first safe edge after drain completes
irq.arm_next: pending_sync && eligible(post_commit_CSR) after normal retirement; otherwise current CSR; trap/IRQ entry clears MIE and arm. Post-state is used only for next arm, never current take.

clarifications: spec 4.2 IF epoch-valid cannot veto an issued D/M owner because its fetch epoch differs
spec 6 IRQ row does not permit same-edge retirement; section 5 is the unique truth table
incomplete irrevocable request waits; its successful completion may retire before later IRQ
a held valid pure read can finish handshake after age-kill and must drain; newly wrong-path requests cannot first present
